defs.def: a sports competition involving a number of teams or players who take part in different games and must leave the competition if they lose. The competition continues until there is only the winner left. 锦标赛；联赛

ex.s: Last Saturday, I went to the school playground to watch the final of the 4x100-metre relay at our annual sports tournament.
ex.t: 上周六，我到学校操场观看了年度体育锦标赛中 4×100 米接力的决赛。

ex.s: The tournament started in 1877 and many of the rules are the same today.
ex.t: 这项锦标赛始于 1877 年，许多规则至今未变。

ex.s: I also did some temporary work for several local sporting events, like the bowling tournament.
ex.t: 我还为几场本地体育赛事做过临时工作，比如保龄球锦标赛。

defs.def: a competition in the Middle Ages between soldiers on horseback fighting to show courage and skill （中世纪的）骑士比武
